attempts.summary: Configured node1 with 640 MiB of compressed zram-backed swap (lz4), active at boot via the zram-config.service systemd unit, with swap priority 100 so it is preferred over any disk-backed swap. Verified functional under real memory pressure, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and swap state, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed changed boot_id and fresh uptime, and verified zram swap and the service auto-recovered identically post-reboot.
